title: Measuring What Matters: Connecting AI Ethics Evaluations to System Attributes, Hazards, and Harms
benchmark_measurement: This paper is a scoping review of existing AI ethics evaluation measures and does not conduct any new measurements or benchmarks. It does not analyze any aspects related to religion or faith.
findings: There are no findings related to religion in this paper. The study focuses on mapping AI ethics measures to system components, attributes, hazards, and harms in a general sense, without specifying religious identity as a category of analysis.
